== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and [[Chief Bast (PC Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original and PC Errata only. Appendix A. Glossary 2.0 already rewrote the printed face (anything he pilots / non-droid character / aboard a starship); that intermediate is not a separate column because [[Chief Bast (Errata)]] does not exist. Do not add Unlimited, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
